hook: Your coding agent can now draft your Apple Mail replies.

beats.say: Mailpipe is a now open-source Mac app that lets an agent you already use draft replies in Apple Mail.
Pick Codex CLI, Claude Code, OpenCode and others. You review, edit and send the reply yourself.
Messages and drafts stay on your Mac, and only the content you authorize goes to your agent. Nothing passes through a Mailpipe server.
